_entry_plan_comment: 入场计划 below is an Issue #298 (schema_version 4) addition -- Deep-Dive-owned execution plan for DEMO1 only, demonstrating the version lineage (plan-demo1-v1 superseded by plan-demo1-v2) and the highest-版本-wins tie-break when a reader sees more than one 状态=active row transiently. DEMO2 and DEMOW1 intentionally have no 入场计划 row at all, demonstrating the fallback path (报告持仓's new 执行状态 columns stay blank and the legacy 参考买入价/区间 + 价格位置 badge is used instead). DEMO1's 报告持仓 rows also carry the Issue #303 Phase 1 (schema_version 5) execution-explanation columns (入场计划版本/入场计划数据时间/行情截至时间/当前阻碍/下次检查/停止条件说明/较上次变化说明), all derivable from plan-demo1-v2's own fields -- this demo plan happens to specify every condition, so none of its rows exercise the "计划未完善：..." incomplete-plan message; that case is covered by dashboard-script.test.js instead. Issue #303 Phase 2 (schema_version 6): plan-demo1-v2 also carries the five Deep-Dive-owned order-policy fields (计划新增仓位币种/计划新增仓位金额/订单类型/订单有效期/跳空处理规则); the superseded plan-demo1-v1 has the same five keys present but blank, demonstrating a plan version written before Phase 2 existed. DEMO1's 报告持仓 rows correspondingly carry 准备状态=无需准备 (执行状态=等待价格, not 可小额开始, so 建议限价/建议订单规模说明 correctly stay blank -- the Dashboard never fabricates a price/size the writer did not populate) alongside the always-populated 计划订单有效期/最近订单状态 snapshot pair. Issue #303 Phase 2 round 3: plan-demo1-v2 also carries the structured 区间1/区间2/区间3上一版本对应区间 batch mapping (区间1/区间2 continue v1's same-numbered zones; 区间3 is declared 新增资金 since v1 had no third zone) and the 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认 manual preflight confirmations (换汇可行性确认 stays blank since the plan currency already matches the demo funding account's own currency); plan-demo1-v1 has all six round-3 fields present but blank, exempt from the write invariant since it has no 上一版本ID of its own. Issue #303 Phase 2 round 4: plan-demo1-v2's 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认 are each paired with their own 确认时间 (dated the same day as the Deep Dive update, well within the freshness window against this demo's report date, and not future-dated); plan-demo1-v1 has all four round-4 fields present but blank, same exemption as the round-3 fields. Issue #303 Phase 2 round 5: the round 4 per-field 换汇可行性确认账户 was replaced by a single shared 订单资金账户 binding all three confirmations; plan-demo1-v2 sets it to 'Demo Broker B' (the 账户状态 row that actually funds this plan's USD orders, matching the plan's own 计划新增仓位币种), since at least one confirmation is populated on that row; 换汇可行性确认/换汇可行性确认时间 stay blank (currencies already match, nothing to confirm); plan-demo1-v1 has 订单资金账户 blank too, consistent with none of its three confirmations being populated.

入场计划._comment: Superseded version -- a reader must never delete/ignore this row (report/plan history is not disposable), but must also never treat it as authoritative once a higher-版本 active row exists. Issue #303 Phase 2 order-policy fields are present but blank -- this version predates that schema addition, same convention as any other pre-existing-field addition. Round 3 batch-mapping/preflight-confirmation fields, and round 4-5's paired confirmation-time/订单资金账户 fields, stay blank too, same reason -- and are exempt from the write invariant since 上一版本ID is itself blank here (first-ever version), and since none of the three confirmations is populated on this row 订单资金账户 isn't required either.

入场计划._comment: Current active plan -- 区间N占比 is relative to planned incremental allocation, never portfolio weight or trade quantity. Issue #303 Phase 2: 计划新增仓位币种/计划新增仓位金额 mirror the amount already described in 计划新增仓位说明, demonstrating the three-fields-together write invariant. Round 3: zone1/zone2 explicitly continue v1's same-numbered zones (write invariant requires this since parent plan id is non-blank and these zone prices are non-blank); zone3 is declared fresh capital since v1 had no third zone. Trading-unit/order-type confirmations are both populated (required for ready-to-prepare), each paired with its own round 4 确认时间 dated the same day as this Deep Dive update (well within the 0-30 day freshness window against this demo's 2026-08-15 报告日期, and not future-dated); since at least one of the three confirmations is populated, round 5's shared 订单资金账户 field is required and is set to 'Demo Broker B' (the USD account in 账户状态 that actually funds this plan's 计划新增仓位币种=USD orders) -- the same account the cash preflight step would look up. FX-feasibility confirmation stays blank because the plan currency matches that account's own currency, so there is nothing to confirm -- 换汇可行性确认时间 stays blank too, matching its own pairing invariant.

_entry_feedback_comment: 入场执行反馈 below is an Issue #303 Phase 2 (schema_version 6) addition -- a durable, user-authorized fact record, append-only (a status update is a new row, never an in-place edit), keyed by (代码, 关联计划ID, 对应区间) with the latest 数据时间 authoritative. The single demo row below records that the user explicitly confirmed, in a 2026-08-15 session, that no order has been placed yet for plan-demo1-v2 (price is still above every zone) -- 报告持仓.最近订单状态 for DEMO1 snapshots this row's 订单状态 verbatim. A code/plan/zone combination with no row here (e.g. DEMO2, which has no 入场计划 at all) is a distinct 未知 state, never treated as 未下单.
